title: rpso (procurement & acquisitions) - u.s. embassy & consulates in germany
paragraphs: the regional procurement support office/frankfurt (rpso) is a forward-based activity of the office of global acquisition – acquisition management directorate – a/ga/amd . rpso’s main objective is to provide foreign service posts worldwide with a responsive and efficient procurement and contracting resource. contact rpso tel.: (49) (69) 7535-3300 fax: (49) (69) 7535-3329 e-mail: frankfurtrpso@state.gov mailing address from outside the u.s.: american consulate general frankfurt rpso giessener strasse 30 60435 frankfurt am main germany mailing address from the u.s.: amcongen attn: rpso unit 7900 box 6000 dpo ae 09213 request for proposal n/a pre-solicitation n/a request for quotation n/a solicitation notices n/a
